D-011.rationale: Cross-DP param checksum divergence after optimizer step is detectable purely from Tier 0 fields; no need for grad/loss/optimizer state.

D-014.rationale: Stale ping-pong buffer manifests as small but systematic grad-norm deviation versus reference; Tier 1 grad stats sufficient (parameter cksum lag would be too noisy at 0.3%).

D-015.rationale: Misplaced overflow return causes optimizer step to be skipped: parameter checksum stays unchanged across steps, observable at Tier 0.

D-021.rationale: Race produces random NaN in partitioned weights; reliable detection needs has_nan flag (Tier 5-6). Param checksum diverges but NaN flag is the canonical signal.

D-025.rationale: EP group built with wrong size (0 groups) only visible via ep_rank topology field; Tier 5-6.

D-026.rationale: MoE expert grads scaled by 1/ep_size — grad_norm on expert params deviates from expected by that factor. Tier 1 grad stats suffice (ep_rank used to scope, but value diff is in grad_norm).

D-027.rationale: Wrong softmax dim is an op-level forward computation issue; no schema field (param/grad/loss/optstate) records intermediate coef tensor's per-dim sum. Source-only.

D-029.rationale: MoE CPU offload averaging on wrong device produces grad_norm differing from reference; Tier 1 grad stats.

D-038.rationale: inf->NaN propagation through clipping detected via has_nan flag on gradients; Tier 5-6 (grad_norm alone wouldn't distinguish NaN from inf reliably).

D-040.rationale: Zero-sized microbatches at DP boundary detectable via per-rank num_tokens field (Tier 5-6); param/grad cksum divergence is downstream and noisy.

M-005.rationale: SwitchMLP router weight cross-TP-rank checksum divergence — canonical Tier 0 case (analogous to few-shot example 1).

M-008.rationale: Loss-scaler stuck => LR pinned at 0; learning_rate field (Tier 3) is the cleanest signal. Loss-trend (Tier 2) also works but LR=0 is more direct.

M-010.rationale: save_to_aux_losses_tracker called twice per step under recompute — Type-B hook function-call count, Tier 5-6 (matches few-shot example 6).

M-012.rationale: expert_bias buffer downcast bf16 vs registered fp32 detected via dtype field; pure Tier 0.

M-014.rationale: topk-then-softmax with k=1 produces zero router gradient — detectable as grad_norm==0 on router.weight at Tier 1.

M-020.rationale: Silent layer drop visible in param_name enumeration across PP ranks (fewer transformer layer names than configured); Tier 0 structural check.

M-021.rationale: Expert params diverge across expert-DP ranks AND stay unchanged across steps — both detectable via Tier 0 param checksum across rank coords.

M-024.rationale: Jitter output dtype promoted bf16->fp32 — a dtype-invariant violation directly captured at Tier 0.

M-033.rationale: Aux-loss gradient scaled 1/dp_size too small — observable in grad_norm of router params at Tier 1.

O-002.rationale: Residual-stream corruption causes initial loss to spike from ~10 to ~60 — Tier 2 loss_value scale check.

O-003.rationale: z-loss averaged over instances rather than tokens — magnitude mismatch visible in loss_value (Tier 2).

O-005.rationale: Forward/backward dropout-mask mismatch is op-level activation divergence; no schema field captures recomputed activation values. Source-only.

O-006.rationale: Dataloader internal start_index not reset; dataloader internal state is explicitly listed unobservable in tier mapping.

O-009.rationale: Wrong k_norm size is a tensor-shape invariant violation — Tier 0 shape field directly catches it.

O-010.rationale: Optimizer state['step'] never increments — directly observable in Adam optimizer state checksum at Tier 4.

O-014.rationale: Training-loop metric-reporting code path; reported throughput value lives outside the parameter/grad/loss/optstate schema. Source-level reporting bug.

O-016.rationale: Missing initial_lr yields wrong LR after checkpoint resume — directly visible in learning_rate field (Tier 3).

O-021.rationale: Mixture rounding inside dataloader produces sample repetition — dataloader internal state, explicitly unobservable per tier mapping.

O-022.rationale: Global Python RNG state corruption affecting reproducibility — dataloader/RNG internal state, not in trace schema.

O-023.rationale: label_mask tensor (intermediate dataloader/loss-construction tensor) dtype/value bug — not captured by parameter/grad/loss schema; op/dataloader-internal.

O-025.rationale: Integer overflow in MFU/flops counter is a metrics-tracking variable outside the parameter/grad/loss/optstate trace schema; source-only.

O-040.rationale: Hardcoded peak-FLOPS constant used only in MFU reporting; no runtime trace field can distinguish 312 vs 624 — source constant.
